setup.title: Initialize your bot.Box server
setup.lead: Enter the one-time setup secret printed in your server output to create the initial owner account and first workspace.
setup.step1Desc: Paste the one-time secret logged on stdout when the API booted.
setup.step2Desc: Configure the administrator credentials that own this deployment.
setup.step3Desc: Name your team hub and select the sandbox runtime driver.
setup.rateLimitNotice: Rate-limited to 5 attempts per 15 min per IP · setup endpoints lock down to 404 permanently once initialized.
setup.terminalHint: Valid while users == 0 · optional BOTBOX_SETUP_SECRET env
setup.terminalLine1: INF migrations applied · database has 0 users · entering first-run setup
setup.invariant1: Setup secret digest is cleared immediately and /api/setup/* permanently returns 404.
setup.invariant2: Owner password is hashed with Argon2id; EdDSA JWT (15 min) + HttpOnly refresh cookie are issued.
setup.invariant3: Every bot, secret and chat is isolated per workspace_id.
setup.invariant4: Additional teammates join exclusively via signed single-use invitation links.
setup.secretHelper: Generated once when the database starts with zero users. Compared in constant time against its stored SHA-256 digest.
setup.passwordHelper: Argon2id hashed · at least 12 characters recommended.
setup.workspaceSlugHelper: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens used in workspace routes.
setup.driverDockerDesc: Local sandbox daemon · Linux desktop containers

secrets.title: {name} · Secrets & network
secrets.lead: Secrets stay encrypted outside the sandbox. The outbound proxy selectively intercepts configured domains to inject credentials after stripping placeholders.
secrets.protectedPushNote: A protected push asks before it is treated as allowed. bot.Box does not run git push and stores no git credential on the card. The git host and the token's rights still decide whether that branch can be updated.
secrets.readOnlyNotice: You have read-only access for this bot's secrets and egress rules.
secrets.howTitle: How a secret leaves the sandbox
secrets.step1Desc: Containers receive NO plaintext keys in env vars or files and use HTTP_PROXY + the bot CA.
secrets.step2Desc: Unknown hosts return 403. Non-secret allowlisted hosts tunnel over raw TCP passthrough.
secrets.step3Desc: Matching HTTPS hosts are decrypted in memory outside the sandbox with audit logging.
secrets.sectionLead: Stored encrypted. Write-only: they can be replaced, never read back.
secrets.howSubtitle: All traffic goes through the proxy: HTTP_PROXY plus an iptables redirect.
secrets.howSandboxNote: Request carries no token. The bot has never seen one.
secrets.howProxyNote: Matching hosts receive the injected header on the way out.
secrets.workspaceScopeAdminOnly: Only workspace owners and admins can add workspace-wide secrets.
secrets.valueReplaceLabel: New secret value (optional — leave blank to keep current)
secrets.savedBanner: Secret encrypted and stored outside the sandbox.
secrets.emptySecrets: No bot or workspace secrets configured yet.
secrets.policyLead: Controls where CONNECT tunnels from the bot sandbox are permitted to connect.
secrets.policyAllowlistDesc: Block all outbound destinations except listed hosts and active secret hosts.
secrets.policyOpenDesc: Allow outbound HTTPS while continuing to inject matching secret headers on the proxy.
secrets.blockedHostsDesc: Explicit blocks override open internet, allowlist entries, and active secrets. *.domain blocks subdomains.
secrets.policyPendingBanner: Outbound policy saved (revision {revision}). Waiting for the running proxy to adopt it.
secrets.policyNotRunningBanner: Outbound policy saved (revision {revision}). It will apply before network access starts on the next bot launch.
secrets.policyDraftConflictBanner: The saved policy updated to revision {revision} while you have unsaved edits in this form.
secrets.policyStateUnknownBanner: Could not verify the current saved policy after an interrupted request. Reload before making changes.
secrets.policyReconciledNotice: The save response was interrupted. Reloaded the authoritative saved policy (revision {revision}).
secrets.egressLead: Query strings and secret payloads are stripped before writing to the egress log.
secrets.triageSyncNote: Allow / Block clicks save immediately against the saved policy.
secrets.emptyLogs: No egress traffic recorded for this filter yet.
secrets.triageUndoConflict: The rule for {host} changed since your last action, so Undo was skipped.
secrets.claudeSubscriptionSetup: On your own computer, run the command below and sign in with your Claude account. Then prepare the form and paste the generated token into Secret value.
secrets.claudeSubscriptionPrivacy: The token is stored encrypted outside the bot computer. The official Claude CLI receives a placeholder. Usage is recorded as tokens only. Never paste this token into chat.
secrets.claudeSubscriptionDockerSetup: Without a local Claude installation, run this project command in your own terminal. It opens a temporary trusted login helper; use the printed browser link and paste the returned code into that terminal.
